original_question: In the setting where a Lie group G acts on the space 𝓜 of holomorphic maps from a homogeneous complex manifold M to Pn, extend Benjamin Weiss’s construction of non-trivial invariant probability measures to this broader action.
target_in_paper: Section 9, Problem 9.3(ii), in the section "Dynamics on the space of maps": the problem asking for an extension of Benjamin Weiss's invariant-measure construction to the induced Lie-group action on a holomorphic mapping space. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1807.05640))
correct_elements: Your draft already captures the right target very closely: a Lie group G acts via a homogeneous complex manifold M on a space of holomorphic maps, and the goal is to extend Weiss's construction of non-trivial invariant probability measures from the translation setting to this broader one. That is exactly the theme of Problem 9.3(ii), not a neighboring problem. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1807.05640))
missing_details: The mapping space should be stated explicitly as the space of holomorphic maps from M to complex projective space P^n, endowed with the topology of uniform convergence on compact sets. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1807.05640))

The induced action should be made explicit: G acts on the mapping space by precomposition with the given action of G on the homogeneous complex manifold M. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1807.05640))

The measure should be specified as a G-invariant Borel probability measure on that mapping space, rather than only saying "extend Weiss's construction," which is too implicit for a stand-alone question. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1807.05640))
The nearby context defines "non-trivial" and this should be included: the measure gives zero mass to the set of constant maps. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1807.05640))
To stay paper-faithful, the question should isolate part (ii) of Problem 9.3 and not merge it with the distinct dense-orbit question in part (i). ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1807.05640))

The draft should indicate that this problem is posed as a direct generalization of the earlier translation-invariant measure setting discussed immediately before Problem 9.3, so that the reference to Weiss is anchored in the paper's actual local context. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1807.05640))

No extra classification language such as "under which conditions" should be added for the measure-construction part, because Problem 9.3(ii) itself is narrower and simply asks for the extension of Weiss's construction. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1807.05640))
refined_question: Let M be a complex manifold that is homogeneous under the action of a Lie group G, and let O(M,P^n) be the space of holomorphic maps M→P^n endowed with the topology of uniform convergence on compact subsets. Via precomposition with the G-action on M, G acts on O(M,P^n). Can Benjamin Weiss's construction of non-trivial invariant probability measures for the translation action on spaces of entire maps be extended to this setting; that is, can one construct G-invariant Borel probability measures on O(M,P^n) that assign measure zero to the set of constant maps? ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1807.05640))
justification: This paper is an open-problems survey, and your draft matches the mapping-space dynamics material in Section 9 rather than the earlier foliation-ergodicity problems. The closest official formulation is Problem 9.3(ii), which appears immediately after the paragraph recalling Weiss's invariant measures and the definition of "non-trivial." The nearby Problem 9.3(i) is a separate dense-orbit question, so a faithful rewrite should keep only the measure-construction part. The published version is in Acta Mathematica Vietnamica 45, pages 103-112. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1807.05640))
